files.body:
Version 2 is planned to extend the protocol with fields such as a request identifier for correlating messages, a timestamp for recording creation time, and an optional payload for carrying application-specific data; these changes are under consideration and are not part of the current release.

Shipped: v2 Hello messages are supported with the explicit `v:2|hello:<name>` envelope.
